hero.manifesto: MJ Cole: "Keep the river flowing rather than getting stagnant." Follow the vibe, finish the idea and move forward: every bassline, every swing and every mistake can open another door.

sound.title: Sound System
sound.statement: My sound lives at the intersection of several worlds: the depth of Deep House, the groove of broken rhythms, the energy of UK culture and the pressure of basslines. I am not interested in staying inside one genre.

genres.label: UK Garage Bassline
genres.note: Shuffled drums, low-end pressure and late-night vocal cuts.

genres.label: Bassline
genres.note: Pressure tools built around rolling subs and warehouse swing.

genres.label: Drum n Bass
genres.note: Fast drums, moving low-end and rave tension with a futuristic pulse.

genres.label: Bass House
genres.note: Club drive, clipped basslines and direct peak-hour movement.

genres.label: Minimal DeepTech / Tech House
genres.note: Reduced grooves, pressure loops and precise room control.

genres.label: Deep House
genres.note: Warm drums, smoked chords and steady underground pacing.

genres.label: Break & Groove
genres.note: Broken rhythm language with jackin energy and rough percussion.

genres.label: House
genres.note: Precise, elegant house groove built for the center of the room.

genres.label: Breaks
genres.note: Broken rhythms, progressive tension and lateral movement.

genres.label: UK Garage SpeedGarage
genres.note: Elastic basslines, British swing and club pressure.
